rows.note: This is the precise, all-purpose term for a tropical rainforest.

example.english: It rains a lot in this rainforest all year round.
example.traditional: 呢片熱帶雨林全年都落好多雨。
example.jyutping: nei1 pin3 jit6 daai3 jyu5 lam4 cyun4 nin4 dou1 lok6 hou2 do1 jyu5

rows.note: Use this shorter form when the tropical setting is already clear from context.

example.english: The travel agency said we would visit a rainforest this time.
example.traditional: 旅行社話我哋今次會去睇雨林。
example.jyutping: leoi5 hang4 se5 waa6 ngo5 dei6 gam1 ci3 wui5 heoi3 tai2 jyu5 lam4
